the CMB data are consistent with the simplest inflationary model in which the curvature perturbation spectrum is scale-invariant.
the CMB anisotropy is not a simple projection of the primordial perturbations on the LSS, but it is a complicated convolution of the primordial spectrum with the LSS thickness and the ISW effect.

the CMB anisotropy data alone are not sufficient to determine both the primordial spectrum and the cosmological parameters.
the CMB data alone can determine the shape of the primordial spectrum, if we assume the correct cosmological model and the correct value of the cosmological constant.
